item.title: Cloud Load Balancer Pricing in India: Fixed Fees, Data Charges and Hidden Costs
item.description: Understand cloud load balancer pricing in India across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Indian providers, including fixed fees, processed data, cross-zone traffic, bandwidth and other hidden costs.

item.title: Cloud VPC Pricing in India: Public IP, NAT, Peering and Hidden Network Costs

item.title: How Much GPU VRAM Do You Need for LLM Inference?
item.description: Learn how much GPU VRAM you need for 7B, 13B, 32B, 70B and larger LLMs, including model weights, quantization, KV cache, context length and concurrency.

item.title: Object Storage Pricing in India: Storage, Requests, Egress and GST Compared
item.description: Understand the real cost of object storage in India, including capacity, API requests, retrieval fees, egress, archive tiers and GST across common cloud pricing models.
